extraction.name: Arabic-Nougat
extraction.description: A suite of OCR models designed to convert Arabic book pages into structured Markdown text, fine-tuned using a synthetic dataset of paired Arabic book pages and Markdown representations.
extraction.creator: Mohamed A. Rashad
extraction.citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad. Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835v1, 2024.
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The primary dataset, arabic-img2md, was created by scraping HTML content from the Hindawi website, converting it to PDFs, and extracting Markdown text to form 13.7k paired samples of Arabic book pages and their Markdown representations. The paper also states that arabic-books contains 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 books using the authors' model.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: HTML content scraped from the Hindawi website, converted to PDFs, with Arabic book pages paired with extracted Markdown representations; additionally, over 8,500 books were used to extract 1.1 billion Arabic tokens for arabic-books.
extraction.rai:dataManipulationProtocol: HTML content was converted to PDFs and Markdown text was extracted to generate paired image-Markdown samples.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: The dataset generation pipeline involved scraping HTML from Hindawi, converting it into PDFs, and extracting Markdown text. For evaluation, a test set of 160 random, unseen Arabic book pages from arabic-img2md was used.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: The paired labels are Markdown representations generated from scraped HTML content and extraction processes rather than manual human annotation.
extraction.rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: All models and datasets are open-sourced, and the implementation is available at the provided GitHub repository.
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The work aims to contribute to document parsing and promote the digitization of underrepresented languages like Arabic. The released arabic-books dataset is described as a valuable resource for future Arabic NLP and OCR research.
extraction.rai:dataBiases: The arabic-img2md dataset is derived from Hindawi's web content and may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents.
extraction.rai:dataLimitations: Limitations include hallucination in arabic-small-nougat, repetition issues in arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat, dataset bias from reliance on Hindawi web content, significant computational requirements for training arabic-large-nougat, limited testing on multilingual or mixed-script documents, and reduced effectiveness on highly irregular or multi-modal layouts such as dense tables, charts, or images.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: The dataset was used to train arabic-base-nougat and arabic-large-nougat and to evaluate model performance using a test set of 160 random, unseen Arabic book pages. The models are intended for Arabic OCR and Markdown extraction from book pages. The paper recommends arabic-base-nougat for general text extraction tasks and arabic-large-nougat for lengthy or complex documents.
